name: facebook group scout
description: Monitors a named set of Facebook groups for one business and surfaces the new posts that merit a reply, checking on a weekday schedule to keep costs and chat volume down. Scoped to a single account's groups, and it flags opportunities rather than answering them.

official.title: Facebook group scout by Josh
official.description: Facebook-group scout for one small business. Watches named groups and flags new posts worth a reply, on a cheap weekday schedule so a fat main chat does...
